title: An Open-Source Terminal UI for Azure DevOps
content_html:
Hi HN,

We built Adotui, an open-source Terminal User Interface (TUI) for Azure DevOps.

https://techniumlabs.github.io/adotui/

The Problem: Like many of you, We have to use Azure DevOps for work, but constantly context-switching out of our terminal into a heavy web UI for pull requests.

The Solution: Adotui is designed to give you fast, keyboard-centric access to your ADO PR right from the command line. It’s built with bun, Typescript, Ink and React.

We built this to scratch our own itch, but I'm open-sourcing it hoping it makes ADO a bit more bearable for other terminal-dwelling devs. Would love to hear your feedback, feature requests, or thoughts on the UI/UX!

Thanks
